@@ -0,0 +1,444 @@
+"""
+SSRF-safe image loading utilities.
+
+Loads images only from:
+1. ``data:image/...`` URLs (decoded in-memory, no network access)
+2. Our configured object storage (relative storage keys or URLs matching
+   ``settings.STORAGE_HOST``, loaded via ``storage.download_image``)
+3. Public ``http://`` / ``https://`` URLs whose resolved IPs are strictly
+   globally routable (blocking loopback, private, link-local, metadata,
+   reserved, multicast, CGNAT, and DNS-rebinding/unsafe-redirect targets).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import io
+import ipaddress
+import re
+import socket
+import threading
+import urllib.parse
+from typing import Optional
+
+from PIL import Image
+import requests
+import urllib3.util.connection
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 50 * 1024 * 1024  # 50 MiB
+MAX_REDIRECTS = 5
+_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODES = {301, 302, 303, 307, 308}
+
+_BLOCKED_IPV4_NETWORKS = (
+    ipaddress.ip_network("0.0.0.0/8"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("10.0.0.0/8"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("100.64.0.0/10"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("127.0.0.0/8"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("169.254.0.0/16"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("172.16.0.0/12"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("192.0.0.0/24"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("192.0.2.0/24"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("192.88.99.0/24"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("192.168.0.0/16"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("198.18.0.0/15"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("198.51.100.0/24"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("203.0.113.0/24"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("224.0.0.0/4"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("240.0.0.0/4"),
+)
+
+_BLOCKED_IPV6_NETWORKS = (
+    ipaddress.ip_network("::/128"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("::1/128"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("::/96"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("::ffff:0:0/96"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("64:ff9b::/96"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("64:ff9b:1::/48"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("100::/64"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("2001::/32"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("2001:2::/48"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("2001:db8::/32"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("2002::/16"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("fc00::/7"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("fe80::/10"),
+    ipaddress.ip_network("ff00::/8"),
+)
+
+_BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES = {"localhost", "metadata", "metadata.google.internal"}
+_BLOCKED_SUFFIXES = (".localhost", ".local", ".internal", ".localdomain", ".arpa")
+_NUMERIC_LABEL_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|0[0-7]+|\d+)$")
+
+_tls = threading.local()
+_orig_create_connection = urllib3.util.connection.create_connection
+
+
+class UnsafeImageURLError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when an image URL targets an internal, private, or disallowed address."""
+
+
+def is_public_ip(ip: ipaddress.IPv4Address | ipaddress.IPv6Address) -> bool:
+    """Return True only if ``ip`` is globally routable and not in any internal/reserved range."""
+    if isinstance(ip, ipaddress.IPv6Address):
+        if ip.ipv4_mapped is not None:
+            return is_public_ip(ip.ipv4_mapped)
+        if any(ip in net for net in _BLOCKED_IPV6_NETWORKS):
+            return False
+    else:
+        if any(ip in net for net in _BLOCKED_IPV4_NETWORKS):
+            return False
+
+    return (
+        ip.is_global
+        and not ip.is_private
+        and not ip.is_loopback
+        and not ip.is_link_local
+        and not ip.is_multicast
+        and not ip.is_reserved
+        and not ip.is_unspecified
+    )
+
+
+def _guarded_create_connection(
+    address: tuple[str, int],
+    timeout=urllib3.util.connection._DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+    source_address: tuple[str, int] | None = None,
+    socket_options=None,
+) -> socket.socket:
+    """Pin urllib3 TCP connections to pre-validated public IPs during safe fetches."""
+    pinned: dict[tuple[str, int], list[tuple]] | None = getattr(_tls, "pinned_addrs", None)
+    if pinned is None:
+        return _orig_create_connection(
+            address,
+            timeout=timeout,
+            source_address=source_address,
+            socket_options=socket_options,
+        )
+
+    host, port = address
+    norm_host = host.strip("[]").rstrip(".").lower()
+    entries = pinned.get((norm_host, port))
+    if not entries:
+        raise OSError(f"Refusing unvalidated connection target: {host}:{port}")
+
+    err: OSError | None = None
+    for af, socktype, proto, _canonname, sa in entries:
+        ip_str = sa[0]
+        if "%" in ip_str:
+            raise OSError(f"Refusing scoped IP address: {ip_str}")
+        if not is_public_ip(ipaddress.ip_address(ip_str)):
+            raise OSError(f"Refusing non-public IP address: {ip_str}")
+
+        sock = None
+        try:
+            sock = socket.socket(af, socktype, proto)
+            urllib3.util.connection._set_socket_options(sock, socket_options)
+            if timeout is not urllib3.util.connection._DEFAULT_TIMEOUT:
+                sock.settimeout(timeout)
+            if source_address:
+                sock.bind(source_address)
+            sock.connect(sa)
+            err = None
+            return sock
+        except OSError as exc:
+            err = exc
+            if sock is not None:
+                sock.close()
+
+    if err is not None:
+        raise err
+    raise OSError("No validated addresses available")
+
+
+urllib3.util.connection.create_connection = _guarded_create_connection
+
+
+def _has_control_or_space(value: str) -> bool:
+    return any(ord(ch) <= 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in value)
+
+
+def _is_safe_relative_storage_path(path: str) -> bool:
+    if not path or _has_control_or_space(path):
+        return False
+    if path.startswith(("/", "\\")) or "\\" in path or "?" in path or "#" in path:
+        return False
+    if ".." in path.split("/"):
+        return False
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(path)
+    if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc:
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def _extract_storage_key_from_url(url: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """If ``url`` points to ``settings.STORAGE_HOST``, return its storage object key."""
+    storage_host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").strip().rstrip("/")
+    if not storage_host:
+        return None
+    base = urllib.parse.urlsplit(storage_host)
+    if base.scheme.lower() not in ("http", "https") or not base.netloc:
+        return None
+    if (base.hostname or "").lower() == "none":
+        return None
+
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
+    base_scheme = base.scheme.lower()
+    parsed_scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
+    try:
+        base_port = base.port or (443 if base_scheme == "https" else 80)
+        parsed_port = parsed.port or (443 if parsed_scheme == "https" else 80)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    if (
+        parsed_scheme != base_scheme
+        or (parsed.hostname or "").lower() != (base.hostname or "").lower()
+        or parsed_port != base_port
+        or parsed.username is not None
+        or parsed.password is not None
+        or "@" in parsed.netloc
+        or parsed.query
+        or parsed.fragment
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    base_path = base.path.rstrip("/")
+    if base_path:
+        prefix = f"{base_path}/"
+        if not parsed.path.startswith(prefix):
+            return None
+        raw_rel = parsed.path[len(prefix):]
+    else:
+        if not parsed.path.startswith("/"):
+            return None
+        raw_rel = parsed.path[1:]
+
+    rel = urllib.parse.unquote(raw_rel)
+    if not _is_safe_relative_storage_path(rel):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid storage object path")
+    return rel
+
+
+def _classify_source(source: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Classify an image source into ('data' | 'storage' | 'http', normalized_value)."""
+    if not isinstance(source, str):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Image source must be a string")
+    cleaned = source.strip()
+    if not cleaned:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Empty image source")
+
+    lower = cleaned.lower()
+    if lower.startswith("data:"):
+        if not lower.startswith("data:image/") or "," not in cleaned:
+            raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid data image URL")
+        return ("data", cleaned)
+
+    if _has_control_or_space(cleaned):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Image URL contains invalid whitespace or control characters")
+
+    if lower.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+        storage_key = _extract_storage_key_from_url(cleaned)
+        if storage_key is not None:
+            return ("storage", storage_key)
+        return ("http", cleaned)
+
+    if _is_safe_relative_storage_path(cleaned):
+        return ("storage", cleaned)
+
+    raise UnsafeImageURLError("Unsupported or unsafe image source")
+
+
+def _resolve_and_validate_http_url(url: str) -> tuple[str, int, list[tuple]]:
+    """Validate an external HTTP(S) URL and resolve it to public IP socket entries."""
+    if not url.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")) or _has_control_or_space(url):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid HTTP(S) URL")
+
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
+    scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
+    if scheme not in ("http", "https") or not parsed.netloc:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid HTTP(S) URL")
+    if parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None or "@" in parsed.netloc:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Credentials in image URL are not allowed")
+    if "\\" in parsed.netloc:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid characters in URL host")
+
+    try:
+        port = parsed.port
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid port in image URL") from exc
+    if port is None:
+        port = 443 if scheme == "https" else 80
+    elif port < 1 or port > 65535:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid port in image URL")
+
+    hostname = parsed.hostname
+    if not hostname or "%" in hostname:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid hostname in image URL")
+
+    norm_host = hostname.rstrip(".").lower()
+    if not norm_host or norm_host in _BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES or norm_host.endswith(_BLOCKED_SUFFIXES):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Internal or local hostnames are not allowed")
+
+    try:
+        ip_literal = ipaddress.ip_address(norm_host)
+    except ValueError:
+        ip_literal = None
+
+    if ip_literal is not None:
+        if not is_public_ip(ip_literal):
+            raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"Non-public IP address is not allowed: {ip_literal}")
+        family = socket.AF_INET6 if ip_literal.version == 6 else socket.AF_INET
+        sa = (str(ip_literal), port, 0, 0) if family == socket.AF_INET6 else (str(ip_literal), port)
+        return norm_host, port, [(family, socket.SOCK_STREAM, socket.IPPROTO_TCP, "", sa)]
+
+    # Reject single-label internal hosts (e.g., "minio", "redis") and numeric/octal/hex IP obfuscations.
+    labels = norm_host.split(".")
+    if len(labels) < 2:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Single-label hostnames are not allowed")
+    if all(_NUMERIC_LABEL_RE.match(lbl) for lbl in labels):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Non-standard numeric hostnames are not allowed")
+
+    try:
+        addrinfo = socket.getaddrinfo(norm_host, port, family=socket.AF_UNSPEC, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    except socket.gaierror as exc:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"Could not resolve hostname: {norm_host}") from exc
+
+    if not addrinfo:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"No addresses resolved for hostname: {norm_host}")
+
+    validated_entries: list[tuple] = []
+    for af, socktype, proto, canonname, sa in addrinfo:
+        ip_str = sa[0]
+        if "%" in ip_str:
+            raise UnsafeImageURLError("Scoped IP addresses are not allowed")
+        ip_obj = ipaddress.ip_address(ip_str)
+        if not is_public_ip(ip_obj):
+            raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"Resolved IP address is not public: {ip_obj}")
+        validated_entries.append((af, socktype, proto, canonname, sa))
+
+    return norm_host, port, validated_entries
+
+
+def _decode_data_image_url(data_url: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    header, encoded = data_url.split(",", 1)
+    if ";base64" in header.lower():
+        compact = "".join(encoded.split())
+        if not compact:
+            return None
+        return base64.b64decode(compact)
+    raw = urllib.parse.unquote_to_bytes(encoded)
+    return raw or None
+
+
+def _fetch_public_http_bytes(url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    current_url = url
+    session = requests.Session()
+    session.trust_env = False
+
+    try:
+        for _ in range(MAX_REDIRECTS + 1):
+            norm_host, port, validated_entries = _resolve_and_validate_http_url(current_url)
+            prev_pinned = getattr(_tls, "pinned_addrs", None)
+            _tls.pinned_addrs = {(norm_host, port): validated_entries}
+            resp = None
+            try:
+                resp = session.get(
+                    current_url,
+                    timeout=timeout,
+                    allow_redirects=False,
+                    stream=True,
+                )
+            finally:
+                _tls.pinned_addrs = prev_pinned
+
+            try:
+                if resp.status_code in _REDIRECT_STATUS_CODES:
+                    location = resp.headers.get("location")
+                    if not location:
+                        return None
+                    next_url = urllib.parse.urljoin(current_url, location.strip())
+                    if not next_url.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+                        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Unsafe redirect target scheme")
+                    current_url = next_url
+                    continue
+
+                if resp.status_code != 200:
+                    return None
+
+                chunks: list[bytes] = []
+                total = 0
+                for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=65536):
+                    if not chunk:
+                        continue
+                    total += len(chunk)
+                    if total > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
+                        logger.warning("Image download exceeded max size limit", url=current_url[:100])
+                        return None
+                    chunks.append(chunk)
+                return b"".join(chunks)
+            finally:
+                resp.close()
+
+        logger.warning("Too many redirects while downloading image", url=url[:100])
+        return None
+    finally:
+        session.close()
+
+
+def is_allowed_image_source(source: str) -> bool:
+    """Validate whether ``source`` is an allowed data:, storage, or public HTTP(S) image source."""
+    try:
+        kind, value = _classify_source(source)
+        if kind == "http":
+            _resolve_and_validate_http_url(value)
+        return True
+    except UnsafeImageURLError:
+        return False
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(source: str, timeout: int = 30) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """
+    Safely load image bytes from a data:image URL, our storage, or a validated public URL.
+
+    Never performs HTTP requests to private, loopback, link-local, metadata,
+    or otherwise non-public network addresses. Returns ``None`` on error or
+    when the URL is blocked.
+    """
+    if not source:
+        return None
+    try:
+        kind, value = _classify_source(source)
+        if kind == "data":
+            return _decode_data_image_url(value)
+        if kind == "storage":
+            return storage.download_image(value)
+        return _fetch_public_http_bytes(value, timeout=timeout)
+    except UnsafeImageURLError as exc:
+        logger.warning("Blocked unsafe image source", reason=str(exc))
+        return None
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image", error=str(exc))
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_pil(
+    source: str,
+    timeout: int = 30,
+    convert_mode: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Optional[Image.Image]:
+    """Safely load an image and return it as an opened PIL ``Image``."""
+    img_bytes = load_image_bytes(source, timeout=timeout)
+    if not img_bytes:
+        return None
+    try:
+        img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))
+        if convert_mode:
+            return img.convert(convert_mode)
+        return img
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to decode image bytes", error=str(exc))
+        return None

+"""Tests for reporting skipped/missing cuts on episode export."""
+
+import io
+import zipfile
+

+

+def _create_episode_with_cuts(client, headers, cut_specs):
+    proj_resp = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/projects",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Missing Cuts Ep", "genre_ids": []},
+    )
+    assert proj_resp.status_code == 200, proj_resp.text
+    project_id = proj_resp.json()["id"]
+
+    ep_resp = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Episode 1", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert ep_resp.status_code == 200, ep_resp.text
+    episode_id = ep_resp.json()["id"]
+
+    for cut_order, image_path in cut_specs:
+        r = client.post(
+            "/api/v1/cuts",
+            headers=headers,
+            json={
+                "episode_id": episode_id,
+                "cut_order": cut_order,
+                "script": f"Panel {cut_order}",
+                "image_path": image_path,
+            },
+        )
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    return episode_id
+
+
+def test_export_reports_missing_cuts_for_zip_and_webtoon(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    valid_key_1 = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="ok-1")
+    valid_key_5 = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="ok-5")
+    corrupt_key_6 = storage.upload_image(b"not-a-valid-image", schema="cuts", identifier="bad-6")
+
+    episode_id = _create_episode_with_cuts(
+        client,
+        headers,
+        [
+            (1, valid_key_1),
+            (2, None),  # no image yet
+            (3, "http://127.0.0.1:9999/internal"),  # refused address
+            (4, "cuts/does-not-exist/missing.png"),  # unloadable storage object
+            (5, valid_key_5),
+            (6, corrupt_key_6),  # unloadable image in webtoon PIL pass
+        ],
+    )
+
+    # ZIP export: skips cuts 2, 3, 4 (cut 6 has raw bytes in storage, cuts 1 & 5 are PNGs)
+    zip_resp = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip",
+        headers=headers,
+    )
+    assert zip_resp.status_code == 200, zip_resp.text
+    assert zip_resp.headers.get("X-Missing-Cuts") == "2,3,4"
+
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zip_resp.content)) as zf:
+        assert "missing.txt" in zf.namelist()
+        assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode("utf-8").splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4"]
+
+    # Webtoon export: skips cuts 2, 3, 4, and 6 (PIL fails on corrupt bytes)
+    webtoon_resp = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon",
+        headers=headers,
+    )
+    assert webtoon_resp.status_code == 200, webtoon_resp.text
+    assert webtoon_resp.headers.get("X-Missing-Cuts") == "2,3,4,6"
+
+
+def test_export_with_no_missing_cuts_omits_missing_txt_and_header(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    valid_key_1 = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="clean-1")
+    valid_key_2 = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="clean-2")
+
+    episode_id = _create_episode_with_cuts(
+        client,
+        headers,
+        [
+            (1, valid_key_1),
+            (2, valid_key_2),
+        ],
+    )
+
+    zip_resp = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip",
+        headers=headers,
+    )
+    assert zip_resp.status_code == 200, zip_resp.text
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" not in {k.lower() for k in zip_resp.headers.keys()}
+
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zip_resp.content)) as zf:
+        assert "missing.txt" not in zf.namelist()
+        assert len(zf.namelist()) == 2
+
+    webtoon_resp = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon",
+        headers=headers,
+    )
+    assert webtoon_resp.status_code == 200, webtoon_resp.text
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" not in {k.lower() for k in webtoon_resp.headers.keys()}

+"""Tests ensuring SSRF protection everywhere the backend loads images from URLs."""
+
+import base64

+import zipfile

+import pytest

+
+from app.core.config import settings

+from tests.lab_env import PNG

+@pytest.fixture()
+def internal_http_server():
+    """Spin up a local HTTP server simulating an internal service inside the network."""
+    received_paths: list[str] = []
+
+    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+        def do_GET(self):
+            received_paths.append(self.path)
+            self.send_response(200)
+            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
+            self.end_headers()
+            self.wfile.write(b"INTERNAL_SECRET_RESPONSE")
+
+        def log_message(self, format, *args):
+            return
+
+    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+    thread.start()
+    try:
+        yield server.server_address[1], received_paths
+    finally:
+        server.shutdown()
+        server.server_close()
+
+
+def _create_project_episode_cut(client, headers, image_path=None):
+    proj_resp = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/projects",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "SSRF Test Project", "genre_ids": []},
+    )
+    assert proj_resp.status_code == 200, proj_resp.text
+    project_id = proj_resp.json()["id"]
+
+    ep_resp = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Episode 1", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert ep_resp.status_code == 200, ep_resp.text
+    episode_id = ep_resp.json()["id"]
+
+    cut_resp = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": 1,
+            "script": "Panel 1",
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert cut_resp.status_code == 200, cut_resp.text
+    return project_id, episode_id, cut_resp.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_zip_export_blocks_internal_url_set_via_put_cut(client, internal_http_server):
+    port, received = internal_http_server

+    put_resp = client.put(

+
+    export_resp = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip",

+    assert export_resp.status_code == 400

+def test_zip_export_keeps_storage_and_data_urls_while_skipping_internal_urls(
+    client, internal_http_server
+):
+    port, received = internal_http_server

+    _project_id, episode_id, cut1_id = _create_project_episode_cut(client, headers)
+
+    # 1. Cut 1: relative storage key
+    storage_key_1 = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier=cut1_id)
+    r = client.put(
+        f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut1_id}",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"image_path": storage_key_1},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+
+    # 2. Cut 2: data:image/png;base64,... URL
+    b64_png = base64.b64encode(PNG).decode("ascii")
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": 2,
+            "script": "Panel 2",
+            "image_path": f"data:image/png;base64,{b64_png}",
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+
+    # 3. Cut 3: full STORAGE_HOST URL (as returned by StoryCutOut)
+    storage_key_3 = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier=str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    full_storage_url = f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{storage_key_3}"
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": 3,
+            "script": "Panel 3",
+            "image_path": full_storage_url,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+
+    # 4. Cut 4: internal SSRF URL
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": 4,
+            "script": "Panel 4",
+            "image_path": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/secret",
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+
+    export_resp = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip",
+        headers=headers,
+    )
+    assert export_resp.status_code == 200, export_resp.text
+    assert received == []
+
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(export_resp.content)) as zf:
+        names = sorted(zf.namelist())
+        png_names = [n for n in names if n.endswith(".png")]
+        assert len(png_names) == 3
+        for name in png_names:
+            assert zf.read(name) == PNG
+        assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode("utf-8").splitlines() == ["4"]
+    assert export_resp.headers.get("X-Missing-Cuts") == "4"
+

+def test_blocks_private_dns_resolution_and_unsafe_redirects(monkeypatch, internal_http_server):
+    port, received = internal_http_server
+
+    # 1. Domain resolving to private/loopback IP must be blocked before any HTTP request
+    def fake_getaddrinfo_private(host, port_arg, *args, **kwargs):
+        return [(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, socket.IPPROTO_TCP, "", ("10.20.30.40", port_arg))]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "getaddrinfo", fake_getaddrinfo_private)
+
+    def fail_if_called(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError("HTTP request should not have been attempted")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "get", fail_if_called)
+    assert image_loader.load_image_bytes("https://internal-alias.example.com/img.png") is None
+
+    # 2. Public IP redirecting to internal IP must be blocked without contacting internal server
+    class FakeRedirectResponse:
+        status_code = 302
+        headers = {"location": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/secret"}
+
+        def close(self):
+            pass
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        requests.Session,
+        "get",
+        lambda self, url, **kwargs: FakeRedirectResponse(),
+    )
+    assert image_loader.load_image_bytes("https://93.184.216.34/redirect.png") is None
+    assert received == []
+
+    # 3. Legitimate public domain resolving to public IP succeeds via single DNS lookup
+    getaddrinfo_calls = []
+
+    def fake_getaddrinfo_public(host, port_arg, *args, **kwargs):
+        getaddrinfo_calls.append(host)
+        return [(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, socket.IPPROTO_TCP, "", ("93.184.216.34", port_arg))]
+
+    class FakeOkResponse:
+        status_code = 200
+        headers = {}
+
+        def iter_content(self, chunk_size=65536):
+            yield PNG
+
+        def close(self):
+            pass
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "getaddrinfo", fake_getaddrinfo_public)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        requests.Session,
+        "get",
+        lambda self, url, **kwargs: FakeOkResponse(),
+    )
+    assert image_loader.load_image_bytes("https://cdn.example.com/panel.png") == PNG
+    assert getaddrinfo_calls == ["cdn.example.com"]
+
+
+def test_guarded_create_connection_pins_validated_ips(internal_http_server):
+    port, received = internal_http_server
+    # Even if pinned_addrs is tampered with or mismatched, _guarded_create_connection blocks non-public IPs
+    image_loader._tls.pinned_addrs = {
+        ("evil.example.com", port): [
+            (socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, socket.IPPROTO_TCP, "", ("127.0.0.1", port))
+        ]
+    }
+    try:
+        with pytest.raises(OSError, match="Refusing non-public IP"):
+            image_loader._guarded_create_connection(("evil.example.com", port))
+        with pytest.raises(OSError, match="Refusing unvalidated connection"):
+            image_loader._guarded_create_connection(("other.example.com", port))
+    finally:
+        image_loader._tls.pinned_addrs = None
+
+    assert received == []
+
